note: Trigger-routing suite, minted alongside make-artifact 2026-08-17 (closes #619, LLD-0011); notes updated 2026-08-18 (#650, lld-0020) after artifact-rules slimmed and design:artifact-styling-rules took over visual-styling questions. Positives are BUILD asks — turn/rebuild/render/regenerate an artifact/report page from a design system. Negatives fence the five siblings this capability overlaps trigger vocabulary with: artifact-rules (a procedure-side standards question with no build ask), design:artifact-styling-rules (a visual-styling standards question with no build ask), make-design-system (authoring/grading the token SOURCE), make-doc (drafting a functional document), markdown-to-markup (plain markdown rendering, no design-system consumption).

cases.prompt: turn this report into an artifact page
render this with our design system
build an artifact page from our DESIGN.md and this retro
make a rendered report page using our tokens.json
regenerate the handbook artifact now that the design system updated
compose a handbook artifact from our project's ADRs, PRDs, and LLDs
build an artifact page for this project even though it has no design system yet
why did my mermaid diagram lose its line breaks in this artifact page
cases.note: design:artifact-styling-rules — a visual-styling standards question, no build ask
